name: 左品牌區＋右側文字連結＋分隔線底部列
desc: 左右分居兩側的頁尾：左側堆疊標誌、資訊文字與圖示連結，右側是數欄文字連結，中間留大片空白；底部列上方有一條橫跨內容寬度的分隔線。手機版改為置中堆疊並隱藏文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，分居內容寬度的兩側，中間留大片空白，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約四分之一是品牌區，由上往下放標誌、一個小標題、多行次要資訊文字與一排小圖示連結，小標題、次要資訊文字與小圖示連結都可省略，沒有時省略，其他元素位置不變；右側約四分之一是數欄並排的文字連結，每欄是直向排列的文字連結、沒有小標題，整組靠右、靠上，起始高度略低於標誌、與品牌區的小標題齊平。最下方一列是底部列，上方有一條橫跨頁面內容寬度的分隔線：一行小字靠左，另一側可放另一行小字靠右，沒有時省略。
mobile: 左右兩區改為單欄，所有元素水平置中、由上往下堆疊：標誌、小標題、多行次要資訊文字、一排小圖示連結。手機版隱藏右側的文字連結，只留品牌區與底部列。底部列的分隔線保留並橫跨內容寬度，左右兩側的小字改為上下排列並置中。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Left brand block + right text link columns + bottom bar with divider
en.desc: A footer split to the two sides: the left stacks a logo, secondary text and icon links, the right holds several columns of text links, with a wide empty space between them; a divider spanning the content width sits above the bottom bar. On mobile it becomes a centered stack and the text links are hidden.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into two areas placed at the two sides of the content width with a wide empty space between them, aligned to the page content width: the left quarter or so is the brand block, stacking from top to bottom a logo, a small heading, multiple lines of secondary text and a row of small icon links; the small heading, the secondary text and the icon links are optional; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. The right quarter or so holds several side-by-side columns of text links, each column a vertical list of text links with no group heading; the set is aligned right and to the top, starting slightly lower than the logo, level with the brand block's small heading. At the very bottom is the bottom bar, with a divider above it spanning the page content width: a line of small text aligned left, and optionally another line of small text aligned right on the other side, omitted when there is no content.
en.mobile: The two areas become a single column with every element horizontally centered and stacked top to bottom: logo, small heading, multiple lines of secondary text, and a row of small icon links. On mobile the right-hand text links are hidden, leaving only the brand block and the bottom bar. The bottom bar's divider is kept and spans the content width, and its left and right small text are stacked vertically and centered. There is no motion.
